what.title: What is Agental
what.body: Agental is an AI-powered platform for performers and casting teams, in beta. Each performer builds a profile with their headshots, credits, reel and self-tapes, and an AI assistant prepares application drafts that the performer reviews before anything is sent. Casting teams receive ranked shortlists with the reasoning shown. Representation is not part of the beta.

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.lead: The services linked to your Agental account, what each one shares, and how to change it.
connected.googleWhat: Used to sign you in. Agental receives your name, your email address and your profile picture from Google. Nothing is sent to Google about your profile, your media or your applications.
connected.passwordWhat: Sign in with your email address and a password you chose.
connected.permissions: Permissions: name, email address, profile picture.
connected.keepOne: You always keep at least one way to sign in.
connected.none: No other service is connected. Agental has no access to your social or email accounts.
